description: This file defines a directive class for Angular Dart that manages custom DOM events such as escape key presses and focus behavior for TodoMVC application components.

classes.name: TodoDOMEventDirective
classes.description: An Angular Dart directive that adds event handling capabilities for DOM events like escape key press and focus to DOM elements.

methods.name: initHandler
methods.description: Initializes an event handler for a given stream, preventing duplicate listeners and applying scope updates when events occur.

methods.name: onEscape
methods.description: Setter that binds a handler to execute when the escape key (ESC) is pressed on the associated element.

methods.name: todoFocus
methods.description: Setter that watches a scope expression and focuses the element when the watched value becomes true.
